messages.subject: Davidian Density Estimation
parts:
Hello -- I'm trying to implement Davidian latent density estimation as part of a simulated concurrent calibration using the multipleGroup package, and I get the following error:

Error: Estimating Davidian mean-variance hyper-parameters is not currently supported

Is this dentype option no longer supported?  I tried rolling back to version 1.28 when this option was announced, but I'm getting the same error.

Best,
Nate

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Davidian Density Estimation
parts:
Hi Nate,

This is not a supported feature, unfortunately. The parameterization used in the davidian package relies on a non-linear sin-cos transformation to ensure the prediction space is always correct during the numerical search, and one of the downsides of this is that the mean/variance must be fixed to 0-1, respectively. Hence, without a complete change to this structure, the package must remain limited to this structure. HTH.

Phil
